name: Osteria Francescana
dinnerNote: Tasting menu, 11 courses (à la carte mains €100–150)

menus.name: Tasting menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner, for the whole table; required for 5 or more

alsoTry.name: Francescana at Maria Luigia
alsoTry.note: Nine of Osteria Francescana's best-known dishes at communal tables in Casa Maria Luigia, the Bottura family's country house outside Modena; pairing €170; solo diners welcome

dressCode: No dress code; smart casual fits.
duration: About three hours, depending on the menu.
bookingOpens: Online only, about six months ahead: each month's tables are released at 10am Italian time, usually on the first working day of a month (May 2027 opens on Monday 2 November 2026; June 2027 on Tuesday 1 December).
waitlist: When it's fully booked you can join the waiting list on the booking page.
cancellation: A credit card is needed, and four days before your visit €300 per person is held on it (not charged). Cancelling or changing the number of guests later than a week before, or not turning up, costs €300 per person.
groups: Tables of 2 to 10 guests; larger groups can't book as several tables. Solo diners are welcome at Francescana at Maria Luigia instead.
